fields.Name: T260 - Feature Pipeline Editor Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the pipeline editor dialog (ShowEditor, mj-record-process-editor) — a distinct modal/editor code path from the list+search view.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Feature Pipelines' screen (via application switcher then Feature Pipelines), click the primary '+ New Pipeline' button in the header (or the 'Edit' button on an existing pipeline card). Success is that a modal dialog titled 'Feature Pipeline' opens containing the record-process editor form. You do NOT need to save; confirm the editor renders inside the dialog and can be cancelled/closed. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking New Pipeline (or Edit on a card) opens a 'Feature Pipeline' modal dialog
The dialog contains the record-process editor and can be closed/cancelled without error
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
